messages:
Anya K: Noticed another spike in span gaps this morning (service:search). Looks like missing spans popped for ~45m starting 01:10 UTC. This matches previous incidents where an ETL lag + aggregator change coincided. We need a short remediation plan and who owns what.

Mike L: I can investigate aggregator side. Quick question: did we deploy the dedupe tweak last night? I saw a small deploy at 00:50 UTC.

Priya S: Confirmed, the dedupe tweak was rolled out to canary at 00:48 and promoted at 00:52. I have logs and the deploy link.\/deploys/agg-dedupe-2026-03-20

Jordan (Data Eng): ETL fleet shows a few workers reporting high GC pauses and one leader losing checkpoint commits around 01:05. That would cause a shard to skip writes for ~30-60m. I'm inclined to say it's the classic "checkpoint drift + aggregator regression" pattern.

Anya K: Sounds like we should do a two-track plan: 1) Immediate mitigation: revert aggregator change if it materially affects counts and restart the affected ETL shard(s). 2) Medium-term: add causal monitoring, runbook updates, and a CI smoke for checkpoints.

Mike L: Will open ticket INF-3490 for the revert + hotfix. Plan: rollback aggregator commit, patch tests, then a small canary. ETA for revert: 2h.

Priya S: Revert PR created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3490 . Rolling back to previous aggregator image now.

Jordan (Data Eng): I'll restart the ETL worker that missed checkpoints and kick off a targeted backfill for the affected shard. Also adding a temporary alert: per-shard_spans_ingested drop >30% for 15m -> page oncall.

ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-145 created and linked to INF-3490. Pager notified: oncall@redwood.

Elaine: Updating runbook: added a short checklist "Span gap response" with steps: identify affected shard, restart worker, run targeted backfill, validate counts, notify postmortem. Taking ownership of the doc update and scheduling a postmortem within 48h.

Anya K: Assign owners in postmortem: Mike=aggregator rollback + tests, Jordan=ETL restart + backfill, Priya=deploy hygiene + pre-promote checks, Elaine=runbook + weekly review. Add explicit due dates. Also tag as recurring-pattern.

Mike L: Revert complete. Canary metrics show span counts back to baseline. Pushed hotfix branch for safer dedupe logic; will follow up with a code-level postmortem and unit tests.

Jordan (Data Eng): Backfill started at 02:20 UTC for shard-7. Estimated catch-up 24-30h. Added synthetic span generator to staging to exercise checkpoint behavior.

Priya S: Will add a deploy gating check: require canary span-rate to be within +/-5% of baseline for 15m before promoting. Will create INF-3491 for gating automation.

Elaine: Runbook updated and RB-4250 created for the review meeting. Meeting invite sent for tomorrow 10:30 with stakeholders: data-eng, infra, product-analytics.

Anya K: Criteria for closure: backfill finished, runbook published, deploy gating in place, and no missing_spans alerts for 14 days. If we see a repeat before then we escalate to a P0.

Mike L: I'll add the hotfix notes to INF-3490 and link code PRs.

Jordan (Data Eng): Monitoring additions: dashboard /dash/spans/health, alert rule "per_shard_span_drop" implemented. Also added a periodic job that validates checkpoint timestamps and fails CI if watermarks drift >5min in smoke.

Priya S: INF-3491 created for deploy gating. ETA 4 business days to implement automation.

Elaine: Postmortem scheduled; I put action items into the doc with owners and deadlines.

Anya K: Thanks team. Let's treat this as a high-priority recurring issue until the deploy gates and checkpoint CI are live. We'll reconvene after the backfill completes and again at the review meeting.
